appraisal_events.evidence: Jupien... ne répondant plus par aucun signe à ce manège... se contentant de lisser ses plumes... le baron, tremblant de perdre sa piste, s'élança vivement pour le rattraper... sur la figure de qui le dédain fit place à la joie... La porte de la boutique se referma sur eux... j'aurais pu croire qu'une personne en égorgeait une autre... c'est le plaisir... Pourquoi avez-vous votre menton rasé comme cela, dit-il au baron d'un ton de câlinerie.
appraisal_events.explanation: The wordless courtship escalates through pursuit and coy withholding into an actual, mutual consummation behind Jupien's closed shop door, followed by tender, teasing post-coital banter; the furtive, animal-comparison staging qualifies the mode of attainment but the passage's dominant movement is realized, mutual intimacy for both men.

status_effects.explanation: Charlus's long pursuit culminates in successful, reciprocated intimacy with Jupien, the dominant local outcome despite the anxious, furtive chase that precedes it.
Charlus is admitted across the threshold of Jupien's shop, the door closing on the two of them together and shutting out the observing world.

Jupien controls the pacing of the encounter throughout -- feigning indifference, letting Charlus pursue him, then extending the invitation himself -- and shares fully in the realized intimacy that follows.
Jupien draws Charlus into his own shop and closes the door on them both, marking the crossing into a shared private space from which the narrator is now excluded.
